name: empiri
description: Structured Danish company, financial, ownership, management, people-in-business and property data from Empiri.dk. Some lookups work without signing in: find a company and get its latest annual report, current owners and current management. Everything else requires signing in with an Empiri account that has access to this data. Read-only access to the Central Business Register (CVR), annual reports (XBRL), Statstidende, and the Danish property registers (BBR, valuations, trades, ownership, cadastre, energy labels).

interface.longDescription:
Empiri gives ChatGPT structured, sourced data about Danish companies, the people registered in their management and ownership, and Danish real estate. It is built for professionals who research companies: lawyers, accountants, bankers, journalists, investors, sales and procurement teams.

Without signing in:
- Find a Danish company by name or CVR number.
- Its latest annual report: revenue, profit, equity, key ratios, the auditor's statement.
- Its current owners with capital and voting shares.
- Its current executive board and board of directors.

When signed in with an Empiri account that has access to this data, also the following, including all earlier years and history:
- Company facts from the Central Business Register (CVR): status, legal form, address, industry, purpose, share capital, employees, production units, bankruptcy or reconstruction processes from Statstidende.
- Annual reports year by year: revenue, gross profit, EBIT, net profit, equity, assets, liabilities, key ratios, the auditor's statement and any modified opinion or going-concern note, consolidated and interim figures, and the management's review.
- Ownership: registered owners with capital and voting shares, the chain of owners to the top, subsidiaries, and the full group structure as a graph.
- Management and history: directors, board, auditor, former roles, name and status changes.
- People's registered business roles and ownership, and how companies and people are connected.
- Danish property: buildings and units (BBR), public valuations, sales history, owners (companies in full, private owners by first name only), cadastre, energy labels, soil contamination and area statistics.
- Batch lookups of up to 50 companies or properties, and industry and bankruptcy statistics.

Every answer links to the source page on empiri.dk and states how current each register is. Ownership shares are the intervals registered in CVR (for example 66.67-90%). Key ratios are calculated by Empiri from the reported figures. Empiri reports registered facts; it does not rate companies or people and does not provide credit scores.

Limitations: only Danish registers; annual reports from 2012; amounts are never converted between currencies. Data access is read-only.
defaultPrompt: What was LEGO A/S's revenue last year?
Who sits on the board of Carlsberg A/S?

positive.description: Latest annual report (works with or without signing in)
positive.prompt: Using Empiri, what were LEGO A/S's revenue and net profit in its latest fiscal year?
positive.expected_behavior: Identifies LEGO A/S (CVR 54562519) and reports fiscal year 2025 (1 January to 31 December 2025) from its consolidated (group) annual report: revenue DKK 83,530 million and net profit DKK 16,710 million, with a link to https://empiri.dk/virksomhed/54562519. Works the same with or without signing in. (Figures as of 21 October 2026; they change only when a newer annual report is filed.)

positive.description: Financial development over five years (signed in)
positive.prompt: Using Empiri, how has LEGO A/S developed financially over the last five years?
positive.expected_behavior: Revenue, net profit and equity for fiscal years 2025, 2024, 2023, 2022 and 2021 in DKK, with the empiri.dk link. Revenue: DKK 83,530 / 74,325 / 65,914 / 64,647 / 55,294 million. Net profit: DKK 16,710 / 13,792 / 13,109 / 13,782 / 13,285 million. Equity at the end of 2025: DKK 49,335 million.

positive.description: Ownership and the chain of owners (signed in)
positive.prompt: Using Empiri, who owns LEGO A/S, and who is at the top of the ownership chain?
positive.expected_behavior: Current registered owners of LEGO A/S: LEGO Holding A/S (CVR 28122454) with 66.67-90% of capital and votes, and LEGO Foundation Investments A/S (CVR 16632635) with 25-33.33%, given as the intervals registered in CVR. Upwards: LEGO Holding A/S is owned 100% by KIRKBI A/S (CVR 18591235), whose registered owners are members of the Kirk Kristiansen family. Links to empiri.dk.

positive.description: Property facts and latest sale (signed in)
positive.prompt: Using Empiri, what do we know about the property at Dag Hammarskjölds Allé 13, 2100 København Ø, and when was it last sold?
positive.expected_behavior: BFE 6034627, owned by the company Dag Hammarskjölds Alle 13 ApS (CVR 46263448), latest public valuation DKK 77,000,000. Latest sale: an open-market sale with takeover date 1 March 2026 for DKK 105,000,000 (purchase agreement dated 22 December 2025). Earlier open-market sales in 2015, 2010, 2005 and 2001. Link to https://empiri.dk/ejendom/6034627.

positive.description: A person's registered business roles (signed in)
positive.prompt: Using Empiri, which companies is Kjeld Kirk Kristiansen registered in, and in what roles?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds one person named Kjeld Kirk Kristiansen (person_id 4003909153) and lists his registered roles (39 in total, current and former) with company, CVR number, role and dates, for example KIRKBI A/S (current, with an ownership share of 20-25%), LEGO FONDEN (board, 2016-2022) and LEGO A/S (board, 2016-2019). Links to empiri.dk.

negative.description: Share prices are not Danish register data. Empiri should not be called; ChatGPT answers without it or says the data is not available in Empiri.
negative.prompt: What is Apple's share price today?

negative.description: Empiri does not rate companies or assess creditworthiness. ChatGPT should not present a score as coming from Empiri; it can at most show reported figures and say that Empiri provides registered facts, not credit ratings.
negative.prompt: Give LEGO A/S a credit score from 1 to 10.

negative.description: Empiri does not hold or return CPR numbers or private home addresses. ChatGPT should decline the CPR number and home address and not try to look them up through Empiri.
negative.prompt: What is the home address and CPR number of the CEO of LEGO A/S?

review.commerce_description: Empiri does not sell anything in ChatGPT. Users can sign in to an existing Empiri account and use the data that account already has access to. When the account does not have access to some data, the tool only says so: the plugin shows no plans, prices or links to purchase pages, and has no checkout or payment.

publication.release_notes: 1.0.5: the plugin no longer refers to plans, prices or a pricing page. A tool that the signed-in account cannot use only says that the account does not have access to this data. 1.0.4: test cases updated to the current registered data and phrased so that each one names Empiri; no change to the tools. 1.0.3: the company research skill reads the annual report itself with get_company_annual_report (search, then read from a hit), for notes such as contingent liabilities, related parties and events after the balance sheet date, and for earlier years. 1.0.2: for investigations and due diligence the company research skill also searches the web for what the registers cannot show (reviews, the company website, LinkedIn, news, authority decisions). 1.0.1: the company research skill now covers due diligence and background checks, keeps registered facts, outside claims and interpretation apart, and attributes register facts to the Empiri page they came from. 1.0.0: first release. Without an account: find a Danish company and get its latest annual report, current owners and current management. With a connected Empiri Pro account: read-only access to Danish company data (CVR, annual reports, ownership, management, history, employment), people's registered business roles, and Danish property data (BBR, valuations, trades, ownership, energy labels). Every answer links to the source page on empiri.dk and states how current each register is.
